purpose: camera, ultra-wide lens in Camera.app: /usr/lib/libredwoodcamui.dylib (camera-userland-20261109/src/rwcam_camui.c, build_camui.sh) is put on the root. It does nothing by being there: the kernel has to name it in DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES for the program Camera (and tell that program hw.model N104AP); in the Camera process it sets CAMCaptureCapabilities to single back cameras, so that 0.5x / 1x are the ultra-wide and the wide AVCaptureDevice of RedwoodAudio.driver. Nothing of Camera.app and no plist is changed. A copy that is already there and differs is kept as libredwoodcamui.dylib.prev. Undo: guest-camuw-undo.sh with payload-camuw-undo and owned-camuw-undo.json (the file and the .prev copy removed).
needs: RedwoodAudio.driver of camera-userland-20261109/out/audio.pkg 0f360a1dc9b4... (the ultra-wide stream's zoom reaches the wide camera's view at 2.0)
kernel: hw.model N104AP and DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=/usr/lib/libredwoodcamui.dylib for the program Camera, dyld policy bits 1 and 5 for it
